name: Netflow Health & Quality
description: Pipeline health — direction coverage, DNS resolution, enrichment gaps, suspicious talkers, and quality trends.

0.content:
# Netflow Health & Quality
Is something wrong? Track enrichment gaps, unknown direction %, DNS resolution failures, low-confidence direction, and suspicious talkers.
**Use case:** "Why is so much traffic unknown direction? Which public IPs are not enriched? What is this mystery IP doing?"

1.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| summarize total = count(), unknown_direction = countIf(coalesce(`netflow.flow.direction`, "unknown") == "unknown")
| fieldsAdd unknown_direction_pct = if(total == 0, then: 0.0, else: round(100.0 * unknown_direction / total, decimals: 2))
1.title: Unknown Direction %

10.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| fieldsAdd dst_ip = coalesce(`netflow.destination.ip`, "0.0.0.0")
| filter isIp(dst_ip) and ipIsPublic(toIp(dst_ip)) and isNull(`netflow.destination.provider`)
| summarize
    bytes = sum(toLong(coalesce(`netflow.flow.io.bytes`, 0))),
    flow_count = count(),
    by: {
      dst_ip,
      direction = coalesce(`netflow.flow.direction`, "unknown"),
      protocol = coalesce(`netflow.network.transport`, "unknown")
    }
| fieldsAdd label = concat(dst_ip, " (", direction, "/", protocol, ")")
| sort bytes desc
| limit 20
10.title: Top Unenriched Public IPs (Enrichment Gaps)

11.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| fieldsAdd src_ip = coalesce(`netflow.source.ip`, "0.0.0.0")
| filter isIp(src_ip) and ipIsPublic(toIp(src_ip)) and coalesce(netflow.source.dns.lookup.status, "unknown") == "unresolved"
| fieldsAdd source_identity = if(isNotNull(`netflow.source.hostname`), then: `netflow.source.hostname`, else: concat(src_ip, " (unresolved)"))
| summarize
    records = count(),
    bytes = sum(toLong(coalesce(`netflow.flow.io.bytes`, 0))),
    by: {direction = coalesce(`netflow.flow.direction`, "unknown"), source_identity}
| fieldsAdd label = concat(source_identity, " [", direction, "]")
| sort bytes desc
| limit 20
11.title: Unresolved DNS Hotspots — Sources

12.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| fieldsAdd dst_ip = coalesce(`netflow.destination.ip`, "0.0.0.0")
| filter isIp(dst_ip) and ipIsPublic(toIp(dst_ip)) and coalesce(netflow.destination.dns.lookup.status, "unknown") == "unresolved"
| fieldsAdd destination_identity = if(isNotNull(`netflow.destination.hostname`), then: `netflow.destination.hostname`, else: concat(dst_ip, " (unresolved)"))
| summarize
    records = count(),
    bytes = sum(toLong(coalesce(`netflow.flow.io.bytes`, 0))),
    by: {direction = coalesce(`netflow.flow.direction`, "unknown"), destination_identity}
| fieldsAdd label = concat(destination_identity, " [", direction, "]")
| sort bytes desc
| limit 20
12.title: Unresolved DNS Hotspots — Destinations

13.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| filter coalesce(`netflow.flow.direction`, "unknown") == "inbound" or coalesce(`netflow.flow.direction`, "unknown") == "outbound" or coalesce(`netflow.flow.direction.confidence`, "low") == "low"
| fieldsAdd source_identity = if(isNotNull(`netflow.source.hostname`), then: `netflow.source.hostname`, else: coalesce(`netflow.source.ip`, "unknown"))
| fieldsAdd destination_identity = if(isNotNull(`netflow.destination.hostname`), then: `netflow.destination.hostname`, else: coalesce(`netflow.destination.ip`, "unknown"))
| fieldsAdd talker = concat(source_identity, " → ", destination_identity, " (", coalesce(`netflow.flow.direction`, "unknown"), ")")
| summarize
    bytes = sum(toLong(coalesce(`netflow.flow.io.bytes`, 0))),
    by: {
      talker,
      protocol = coalesce(`netflow.network.transport`, "unknown"),
      dst_provider = coalesce(`netflow.destination.provider`, "unenriched")
    }
| sort bytes desc
| limit 25
13.title: Suspicious Talkers (Inbound / Outbound / Low Confidence)

14.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| fieldsAdd issue = if(coalesce(`netflow.flow.direction`, "unknown") == "unknown", then: "Unknown Direction", else: if(coalesce(`netflow.destination.hostname`, "") == "", then: "Unresolved DNS", else: if((coalesce(`netflow.destination.provider`, "") == "" or coalesce(`netflow.destination.provider`, "") == "private") and coalesce(`netflow.destination.asn`, "") == "", then: "Unenriched IP", else: "OK")))
| filter issue != "OK"
| summarize flow_count = count(), by: {issue}
| sort flow_count desc
14.title: Quality Issue Distribution

15.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability"
    and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| filter coalesce(`netflow.flow.direction`, "unknown") == "unknown"
| fieldsAdd talker = concat(
    coalesce(`netflow.source.ip`, "unknown"), " → ",
    coalesce(`netflow.destination.ip`, "unknown"), " (",
    coalesce(`netflow.network.transport`, "unknown"), ")")
| summarize flow_count = count(), by:{talker}
| sort flow_count desc
| limit 15
15.title: Unknown Direction Talkers (by flow count)

2.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| fieldsAdd src_ip = coalesce(`netflow.source.ip`, "0.0.0.0")
| fieldsAdd dst_ip = coalesce(`netflow.destination.ip`, "0.0.0.0")
| fieldsAdd src_unresolved = coalesce(netflow.source.dns.lookup.status, "unknown") == "unresolved" and isIp(src_ip) and ipIsPublic(toIp(src_ip))
| fieldsAdd dst_unresolved = coalesce(netflow.destination.dns.lookup.status, "unknown") == "unresolved" and isIp(dst_ip) and ipIsPublic(toIp(dst_ip))
| summarize total = count(), unresolved = countIf(src_unresolved or dst_unresolved)
| fieldsAdd unresolved_pct = if(total == 0, then: 0.0, else: round(100.0 * unresolved / total, decimals: 2))
2.title: Unresolved DNS %

3.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| fieldsAdd has_public_src = isIp(coalesce(`netflow.source.ip`, "0.0.0.0")) and ipIsPublic(toIp(coalesce(`netflow.source.ip`, "0.0.0.0")))
| fieldsAdd has_public_dst = isIp(coalesce(`netflow.destination.ip`, "0.0.0.0")) and ipIsPublic(toIp(coalesce(`netflow.destination.ip`, "0.0.0.0")))
| filter has_public_src or has_public_dst
| summarize total_public = count(), enriched = countIf(isNotNull(`netflow.destination.provider`) or isNotNull(`netflow.source.provider`))
| fieldsAdd unenriched_pct = if(total_public == 0, then: 0.0, else: round(100.0 * (total_public - enriched) / total_public, decimals: 1))
3.title: Unenriched Public IPs %

4.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| summarize total = count(), low_conf = countIf(coalesce(`netflow.flow.direction.confidence`, "low") == "low")
| fieldsAdd low_conf_pct = if(total == 0, then: 0.0, else: round(100.0 * low_conf / total, decimals: 2))
4.title: Low Confidence Direction %

5.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| summarize total = count(), with_direction = countIf(isNotNull(`netflow.flow.direction`)), with_hostname = countIf(isNotNull(`netflow.destination.hostname`)), with_enrichment = countIf(isNotNull(`netflow.destination.provider`) and `netflow.destination.provider` != "private")
| fieldsAdd quality_score = if(total == 0, then: 0.0, else: round((with_direction * 0.4 + with_hostname * 0.3 + with_enrichment * 0.3) / total * 100.0, decimals: 1))
5.title: Data Quality Score

6.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| fieldsAdd src_ip = coalesce(`netflow.source.ip`, "0.0.0.0")
| fieldsAdd dst_ip = coalesce(`netflow.destination.ip`, "0.0.0.0")
| fieldsAdd src_unresolved = coalesce(netflow.source.dns.lookup.status, "unknown") == "unresolved" and isIp(src_ip) and ipIsPublic(toIp(src_ip))
| fieldsAdd dst_unresolved = coalesce(netflow.destination.dns.lookup.status, "unknown") == "unresolved" and isIp(dst_ip) and ipIsPublic(toIp(dst_ip))
| makeTimeseries
    total_records = count(),
    unknown_direction = countIf(coalesce(`netflow.flow.direction`, "unknown") == "unknown"),
    unresolved_dns = countIf(src_unresolved or dst_unresolved),
  interval: 5m
6.title: Flow Volume, Unknown Direction & Unresolved DNS Over Time

7.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| makeTimeseries
    total_flows = count(),
    unknown_direction = countIf(coalesce(`netflow.flow.direction`, "unknown") == "unknown"),
    unresolved_dns = countIf(coalesce(`netflow.destination.hostname`, "") == ""),
    unenriched_ips = countIf((coalesce(`netflow.destination.provider`, "") == "" or coalesce(`netflow.destination.provider`, "") == "private") and coalesce(`netflow.destination.asn`, "") == ""),
  interval: 5m
7.title: Data Quality Issues Over Time

8.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| fieldsAdd src_ip = coalesce(`netflow.source.ip`, "0.0.0.0")
| fieldsAdd dst_ip = coalesce(`netflow.destination.ip`, "0.0.0.0")
| fieldsAdd src_unresolved = coalesce(netflow.source.dns.lookup.status, "unknown") == "unresolved" and isIp(src_ip) and ipIsPublic(toIp(src_ip))
| fieldsAdd dst_unresolved = coalesce(netflow.destination.dns.lookup.status, "unknown") == "unresolved" and isIp(dst_ip) and ipIsPublic(toIp(dst_ip))
| filter src_unresolved or dst_unresolved
| makeTimeseries unresolved_records = count(), by: {direction = coalesce(`netflow.flow.direction`, "unknown")}, interval: 5m
8.title: Unresolved DNS by Direction Over Time

9.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| filter coalesce(`netflow.flow.direction`, "unknown") == "unknown"
| fieldsAdd source_identity = if(isNotNull(`netflow.source.hostname`), then: `netflow.source.hostname`, else: concat(coalesce(`netflow.source.ip`, "?"), " (unresolved)"))
| fieldsAdd destination_identity = if(isNotNull(`netflow.destination.hostname`), then: `netflow.destination.hostname`, else: concat(coalesce(`netflow.destination.ip`, "?"), " (unresolved)"))
| fieldsAdd talker = concat(source_identity, " → ", destination_identity)
| summarize
    records = count(),
    bytes = sum(toLong(coalesce(`netflow.flow.io.bytes`, 0))),
    by: {talker, protocol = coalesce(`netflow.network.transport`, "unknown")}
| sort bytes desc
| limit 25
9.title: Unknown Direction Hotspots
